probe.note: No local openclaw package was present under node_modules. Names were probed from public SDK docs and the published memory-state.ts source. Not a compile probe.

names.name: registerMemoryPromptPreparation
names.note: Documented async preparation for a memory-adjacent prompt section. Returns immutable lines for synchronous promptBuilder assembly.

names.name: promptBuilder
names.note: Documented as a registerMemoryCapability field. Synchronous and must remain side-effect free. Not an I/O hook.

names.name: flushPlanResolver
names.note: Documented as a registerMemoryCapability field. Returns a MemoryFlushPlan. It is not a terminal session-close callback.

documented_terminal_callback.note: No documented terminal lifecycle callback with stable session identity was proven. flushPlanResolver is a plan resolver. api.lifecycle.registerRuntimeLifecycle is plugin-resource cleanup on reset/delete/reload, not a Wax checkpoint. Level A remains unproven.

correlation.evidence: registerMemoryPromptPreparation is exposed, so read-only prime is possible. Level A requires that plus a documented terminal callback and ownership of every Wax read/write. Those are not proven.
